data.body: INVESTIGATION (BASIC, confirmed high-confidence): Root cause = TWO detection blocks both gated behind `if [[ ${_RESUME:-0} -eq 1 ]]`: (a) advance-to-PR2 at merge-to-main-pr.sh:2893 (reads staged_branch from state file, re-points BRANCH so _phase_staged_intermediate skips and PR2 opens); (b) GitHub-side open-PR fallback at :2915 (gh pr list --head BRANCH --state open -> populates _RESUME_STATE_PR_URL -> skips _check_duplicate_pr + _phase_merge to resume into the existing open PR). Bare re-invocation sets _RESUME=0 (line 37) so BOTH skip. Proposed fix: remove the `[[ ${_RESUME:-0} -eq 1 ]] &&` prefix from both conditionals so detection runs unconditionally; --resume becomes an optional fast-path. Fail-safe preserved (_resume_should_advance_to_staged defaults to no-advance on gh/git uncertainty; absent/stale state file -> empty staged_branch -> block no-ops). Double-bump guard (lines 620-632, HEAD-subject check) unaffected. NUANCE: this session's repro was scenario B (PR1 open + review-sub-pr failed -> I closed+recreated). Un-gating :2915 is what makes scenario B iterate-in-place. OPEN VERIFICATION before implementing: (1) enumerate EVERY _RESUME reference to confirm 2893/2915 are the only detection gates and no consume-path step (skip _check_duplicate_pr / _phase_merge / re-wait for PR1 checks) is separately _RESUME-gated; (2) confirm the un-gated open-PR path re-waits for PR1's (re-running) review-sub-pr before advancing, not skip-to-PR2-unreviewed.
